data.body:
Every read and write of TOML goes through infra.tomlcfg (read, round-trip write, layered local/project merge); the 30 direct tomllib importers move behind it, tomlkit stays only there. Cooperates with B109 (storage seam). Contract: only the home imports tomllib and tomlkit. Tests first. CONFORMANCE (r-reuse-core, r-small-files, r-everything-configurable, D-unify strangler with ratchets): port = Protocol, one default implementation in its home module, a fake for tests; baseline ignore lists only shrink; no behaviour change for callers; files under 20 KB.

OPERATOR 2026-10-31 (D-adapters-answers): the home is ddflow/adapters/ (not ddflow/infra); strangler, one family per task, baseline lists only shrink.

SPLIT (coordinator 2026-11-04): the toml-home contract and CONTRACTS entry moved to ADP-toml-contract (needs ADP-fs); infra.tomlcfg delegating to TomlIo is ADP-toml-unify. This item lands the TomlIo port, adapter, fake, conformance, doc and the shrink-only baseline file. Two ports by design: Toml = overlay policy, TomlIo = parse/render primitives (see module docstring).

Add contract `toml-home` to .importlinter (forbidden_modules tomllib, tomlkit; source ddflow; allow_indirect_imports True) and "toml-home" to CONTRACTS in tests/test_architecture_import_contracts.py. The shrink-only baseline tests/guard_baselines/importlinter-toml-home.toml landed with ADP-toml (37 entries, 2 are home). Split off ADP-toml so it need not wait for ADP-fs on the same files.

SCOPE GREW (adp-toml, 2026-11-04): ADP-toml landed the READ side only. Its first commit 8382507f6 (branch ddflow/ADP-toml) holds the full version to re-apply: (1) TomlIo.dumps(data_or_document) and document(text) over tomlkit in ddflow/adapters/toml.py (tomlkit.parse errors wrapped into TomlError), with fake and conformance cases; (2) tests/guard_baselines/importlinter-toml-home.toml, 37 entries (2 home: ddflow.adapters.toml -> tomllib/tomlkit; 35 others), git show 8382507f6:tests/guard_baselines/importlinter-toml-home.toml; (3) HOMES["tomlkit"] in tests/architecture_guards_support.py must become ddflow.adapters.toml (the tomlkit ratchet counts the deferred imports; the 'tomlkit' lazy imports also add 2 sites to the deferred_imports baseline unless imported at top level -- choose top level or baseline them, shrink-only) ; (4) the contract and CONTRACTS entry. An orphan baseline file without the contract fails test_every_guard_has_its_own_baseline_file, so (2) and (4) land together. ADP-managed-files and ADP-config-store, if they need dumps/document, should need this item.

data.claim: A tomllib-only TomlIo in ddflow/adapters/toml.py passes the ports contract and the architecture ratchets with no new violation; a tomlkit use there would trip the tomlkit HOMES ratchet and deferred_imports.
data.falsifier: The ratchets stay green with tomlkit used in the new module, or fail with the read-only module.
data.mechanism: HOMES["tomlkit"] names ddflow.infra.tomlcfg as the only home; deferred_imports counts function-level imports.
